scope: synthetic offline whole-clip mono WPE comparison only; no selection, superiority, real-room or release claim

public_boundary.registration: none; this task adds no C provider, descriptor, registry entry or default
public_boundary.note: Whole-clip predictor estimation needs the complete utterance and cannot be represented by the causal 160-sample v0 process() boundary. The v0 grid is used only as the fixture format and for deterministic chunking of an offline buffer.

invariants: Fixed v0 format only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160 samples. The installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
No C provider, provider CMake subtree, descriptor setting, registry entry or installed default is added by this task.
Whole-clip WPE is noncausal and explicitly outside the realtime v0 process() boundary; no target-device timing or release claim is made.

Identity and noisy controls, paired synthetic SI-SDR/STOI, RT60/direct-to-reverb stratification, early-reflection target, spectral tilt and clean-source preservation are all present; no missing result qualifies the candidate.
Rejected frames, invalid settings, stale session/epoch and wrong position fail explicitly and do not mutate DSP/alignment state.

All scores are synthetic-scoped on generated signals; no real speech, model weights, downloads, licensed runtime, listening, MOS/STOI on real speech, target-device pacing or release qualification is claimed.
Canonical reports and synthetic output digests are exact and reproducible from the pinned fixture.
source_evidence_statements: candidate_matrix.csv row 65: offline WPE is a dereverberation candidate sourced from an offline whole-clip algorithm, not an installed SDK provider.
adapters/wpe/README.md: 512-point FFT, 128-hop, 5 taps, 8-frame delay; roughly 80 ms algorithmic latency; offline use is not real time.

research/dereverberation_candidates_20261028.md: offline WPE regressed under the early-reflection target on measured direct-dominated rooms; the synthetic conditions here are a comparison, not a selection or qualification.
blockers: No held-out real-room paired dereverberation eval with pinned RIRs, licenses and an early-reflection target has been run.
No listening/MOS assessment on real speech has been run; synthetic STOI is not a human score.
No target-device CPU, memory, deadline or whole-file latency measurement has been run for any causal variant.
No provider intake, rights, license, descriptor and public catalog review has been completed for any realtime v0 provider.
reopening_conditions: Provide real-room or standards-room RIRs with pinned provenance and a defined early-reflection target, then rerun paired SI-SDR/STOI with identity and noisy controls.
Run listening/MOS with licensed real speech and a declared listener protocol.
Design and measure a causal/streaming WPE variant on the target device against the 160-sample v0 grid before any provider proposal.
Complete provider intake, license and descriptor review before changing any installed default, registry or public catalog.
